fuente.titulo: Pope in Uruguay: Church offers Jesus Christ and hope proclaimed by Gospel

titular: Pope Leo opens Uruguay trip with speech on democracy
bajada: He spoke on the common good, human dignity and care for the most vulnerable
caption: Pope Leo XIV began his Apostolic Journey to Uruguay with an address on the common good, reflecting on democracy, duties toward future generations, human dignity and peaceful coexistence. Source: Vatican News, Nov. 6, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A podium with a national flag of Uruguay beside official buildings in Montevideo at dusk; a robed papal figure stands at upper right addressing an unseen crowd, left and center open and calm.
